notes: Sponsor manifests under a 1-of-1 sponsor authority, verified with a fresh phone state (now = issued + 1 h, or the agent verifier's next epoch where `now` says so). sponsorProof is a credentials.md presentation of one possession leaf from the agent-class verifier, epoch only, verified as a logged presentation against the manifest's issued (ADR 0101); BBS proof bytes and pseudonyms are fixed (P4 pending, so as-bad-proof-scope has no vector). The log-submission cases are the log's clock check; the log of record of a sponsor manifest is the log whose proof its bundle carries (RS6).
